messages:
Rui: Quick thread: considering adding `route_class` (small enum string) to console events to accelerate quota rollups and dashboard aggregates. Goal: avoid heavy JOINs on route metadata at query time.
Lina: enum vs freeform string? enums compress better and index smaller.
Rui: prefer enum: values are 'api','webhook','batch','internal'. Most routes fall into these and it keeps cardinality bounded.
Oscar: how will producers determine class? runtime annotation? static mapping?
Rui: producers will prefer static mapping from route_id -> route_class published in config service. Fallback: simple heuristic by path prefix. We'll emit route_class in the event envelope.
Dee: migration strategy? I want zero downtime and ability to roll back quickly.
Rui: plan: add nullable column to events_v3, index concurrently. Start with producer dual-write to v3 topic for a subset of tenants. Read-layer will read route_class when present; otherwise derive from route_id via mapping service.
Lina: DDL sketch?
Rui: SQL snippet:
```sql
ALTER TABLE events_v3 ADD COLUMN route_class text;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_events_v3_route_class ON events_v3(route_class) WHERE route_class IS NOT NULL;
```
Dee: backfill approach? I vote for on-the-fly backfill for hot time windows and lazy for cold data.
Oscar: agree. Also avoid adding a btree on all tenants at once. Do per-tenant index materialization if necessary.
storage-bot: note: cluster 5 has 12% spare IO headroom; safe for limited backfill.
Lina: quota semantics: if we group by route_class instead of route_id, consumption buckets will change. How do we keep billing/quota parity?
Rui: we'll keep quota-service backward-compatible: it will prefer route_class when a tenant has opted into 'class-rollups' feature flag. For others it keeps route_id grouping. We need a reconciliation job to surface any drift during rollouts.
Dee: what metrics to track?
Rui: write-side: route_class_emit_rate, failed_mapping_rate. Read-side: route_class_read_hit, query_p99_reduction. Storage: per-tenant index_size_delta.
Oscar: long-running analytics jobs: they need schema update to use route_class when available. We'll coordinate with analytics team to accept both shapes.
Lina: safety knobs: producer kill-switch, per-tenant opt-out, and backfill throttling with circuit breaker.
Rui: timeline proposal: day0 - deploy schema change (nullable), day1 - enable producer flag in canary for 5 tenants, day3 - enable read-adapter logic and metrics, day7 - decide on broader rollout + backfill for top N tenants.
Dee: +1. I'll draft the rollback runbook (how to stop producers and remove index).
Rui: thanks. I'll open the PR with DDL and a short playbook. Ping me for reviews. :rocket:
